serviceName: DKIM for your own letr.dev account
description: Publishes the DKIM key a letr.dev account signs the domain's email with, at the selector letr.dev gives the domain.
variableDescription: %dkimSelector%: the domain's own DKIM selector, e.g. letr-k3x9q2m7; %dkimKey%: the domain's DKIM public key, base64
